text.abstract: Authors come from `git blame` on each session's `events.ndjson`, so nothing new is stored and there is no setting; the plan's stored `meta.json` author and show/hide toggle were dropped after review. The engine (`authors.ts`, `AuthorIndex`, `GET /api/sessions/:id/authors`, commit 721dd4a) and the UI (`Avatar.tsx`, `takeovers()` marking the same part in Reader and Graph, hover card "by X", commit 211ffc3) are committed, with 97 tests and typecheck passing and a two-identity scratch repo checked in the browser. Forked sessions from `resume` still credit their copied history to whoever resumed, which needs the planned spike on whether forks keep the original event ids.
